name: LC Fine Foods
old_description: LC Cash and Carry, also known as LC Fine Food, is an establishment steeped in history, founded by the late and great Italo “Leo” Ciocca in the year 1965. Leo’s vision was to offer the finest Italian imports to his esteemed clientele. With his unwavering commitment to excellence and his unbridled passion for the food industry, Leo expanded his business, reaching new heights of success, while simultaneously adding new products and acquiring new customers across the wholesale and retail sectors. Today, his legacy lives on through LC Cash and Carry, where the tradition of offering authentic Italian products still remains strong, while at the same time, embracing the evolution of the market by adding a vast assortment of domestic products to cater to a wider audience.
about:
LC Fine Foods, operating as LC Cash and Carry, has been a fixture in New Haven, Connecticut since 1965. The company was founded by Italian immigrant Italo "Leo" Ciocca, who envisioned bringing the finest Italian imports to his community. What began as a modest enterprise grew into a family-owned wholesale and retail food business that continues under the leadership of Ciocca's children, Carlo and Danny.

The company distributes a broad assortment of Italian and domestic food products across categories that include produce, deli meats, cheeses, pasta, olive oils, bakery goods, coffee, and seasonal specialties. From a remodeled storefront in New Haven, LC Fine Foods serves both wholesale accounts and walk-in retail customers, offering delivery service throughout the region.

Its customer base spans restaurants, delicatessens, institutional kitchens, and individual consumers. A deli operator in New Haven County cites the company as a primary supplier for fresh produce and cold cuts, while retail shoppers seek out traditional items such as panettone and pandoro during the holidays.

Ciocca's original commitment to quality and personal service remains the stated differentiator. The company emphasizes long-standing supplier relationships, both domestic and international, and a practice of sourcing from local farmers and dairy producers whenever possible to support the surrounding community.
